title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots

settings.note: Cutscenes, specifically pre-recorded cutscenes, are difficult to skip if the FPS is too high. When pausing to skip a cutscene it unpauses very quickly on its own. Capping the FPS fixes this issue. See [[Metal_Gear_Solid_4:_Guns_of_the_Patriots#Special_Notes|Special Notes]].
Fixes bright scenes while in-game, but expect a small performance hit.
Improves performance, and should help with stability.
Required to properly play FMV cutscenes

patches.name: Unlock FPS
patches.note: Unlocks the FPS + can improve performance.
